papers.title: Pupil size-resting state network coupling in major depressive disorder: a longitudinal iTBS study
papers.summary: We found 17 t-tests and/or F-tests where effect sizes are not reported. Check these tests in the table below, and consider adding effect sizes.

findings.sentence: Across all seven networks considered for the pupil-RSNs coupling (visual, dorsal and ventral DMN, left and right ECN, SN, DAN+VAN system), the lECN was the only network showing a significant longitudinal change in its coupling with pupil size across visits (F(3,131) = 4.95, pFDR = 0.01, Figure 5).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: Exploratory analyses on this primary finding indicated that longitudinal changes in pupil size-lECN coupling did not differ significantly by intervention sequence (activesham vs. sham-active), as reflected by the Visit x Sequence interaction (F(3,128) = 0.23, p = 0.86; Fig. 7).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: This interaction was significant (F(3,120) = 4.02, p = 0.009), indicating that the longitudinal pattern of pupil-lECN coupling differed as a function of treatment sequence and responder status.
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: Significant lower-order interactions were also observed for Visit × Responder status (F(3,120) = 2.70, p = 0.04) and Sequence × Responder status (F(1,120) = 7.50, p = 0.007).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: Significant lower-order interactions were also observed for Visit × Responder status (F(3,120) = 2.70, p = 0.04) and Sequence × Responder status (F(1,120) = 7.50, p = 0.007).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: Finally, exploratory analyses of BAI total scores revealed that anxiety symptoms did not significantly moderate pupil size-lECN coupling in the full longitudinal LME (F(3, 127) = 0.34, p = 0.79).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: Furthermore, the Visit x Sequence x BAI interaction was not significant (F(3,120) = 0.44, p = 0.72), providing no evidence that intervention sequence further moderated the longitudinal association between anxiety symptoms and pupil-lECN coupling.
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: Considering all four intervention-related visits, mean pupil diameter did not show a significant longitudinal change (F(3,131) = 2.16, p = 0.09).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: Sensitivity analyses excluding these two observations resulted in a nominally significant longitudinal Visit effect (F(3,128) = 3.80, p = 0.01; Supplementary Materials Fig. S8).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: Notably, the LME analysis of tonic pupillary responses also revealed a significant lower-order effect of age (F(1,131) = 4.71, p = 0.03), which is further described in the Supplementary Materials (Fig. S9).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: Finally, longitudinal changes in mean pupil diameter were not significantly moderated by treatment sequence (F(3,128) = 0.51, p = 0.67; Fig. S10) or treatment response (F(3,127) = 0.84, p = 0.47; Fig. S11A-S11B).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: Finally, longitudinal changes in mean pupil diameter were not significantly moderated by treatment sequence (F(3,128) = 0.51, p = 0.67; Fig. S10) or treatment response (F(3,127) = 0.84, p = 0.47; Fig. S11A-S11B).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: The Visit × Sequence × MADRS (responder status) was also not significant (F(3,120) = 1.95, p = 0.12).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: When additional exploratory analyses were conducted using BAI total scores, the full LME model did not reveal a significant Visit × BAI interaction in relation to longitudinal changes in mean pupil diameter across the four visits (F(3, 127) = 1.99, p = 0.11; see Supplementary Materials, Fig. S13).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: The three-way Visit x BAI score x Sequence interaction was also not significant (F(3, 120) = 0.47, p = 0.69).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: The analysis revealed a significant longitudinal effect of Visit on pupil size-lECN coupling (F(3,131) = 4.95, pFDR = 0.01).
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.

findings.sentence: The Visit and the Visit × Sequence interaction was not statistically significant (F(3,128) = 0.23, p = 0.86), indicating no evidence that longitudinal changes in pupli-lECN coupling differ by intervention sequence.
